decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with instant and sorcery spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays and card advantage. The deck includes several card draw and selection spells to help dig for the key pieces needed to quickly bring back the Phoenix. Additionally, disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Ashiok, Dream Render are included to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from mounting a defense against the aggressive onslaught.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize sacrifice synergies to build a board presence and control the game through a quick, aggressive playstyle. This is achieved by combining cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Fatal Push to control the board, generate value, and deal damage while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Ygra, Eater of All adds a powerful finisher to the deck, allowing for additional pressure and resilience against removal spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats and constant threat activations.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play Arclight Phoenix alongside efficient spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to quickly fill the graveyard and bring back the Phoenix. The deck also includes cards like Ledger Shredder and Treasure Cruise to help with card advantage and digging for key pieces. With a focus on fast, proactive plays and utilizing powerful graveyard synergies, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using cards like Thraben Inspector and Venerated Loxodon to quickly build a strong board presence. The inclusion of Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helps to disrupt opponents' game plans while cards like Gleeful Demolition provide removal options. The deck also utilizes Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion to provide an extra source of mana. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast and efficient creatures while maintaining pressure on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and utilize powerful instant and sorcery spells to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently cast cheap spells to trigger the Phoenix's revival ability and overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The inclusion of cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe help deal with threats while keeping up the pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to quickly close out games through a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient spells.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board with efficient removal spells and disruptive creatures while also utilizing card draw and graveyard mechanics to bring back powerful threats like Arclight Phoenix. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and pressure the opponent while also maintaining card advantage to outpace them in the long run.Using a combination of burn spells, card draw, and graveyard recursion, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and spells quickly to overwhelm your opponent with fast damage. By utilizing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Aloe Alchemist, along with powerful spells like Atarka's Command and Play with Fire, you can put pressure on your opponent early in the game. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional direct damage options, while Burning-Tree Emissary helps you cast multiple spells in a turn. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and fast-paced, aiming to win the game quickly before your opponent can stabilize.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through various spells and abilities, with a strong emphasis on removal and disruption tactics. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and utility to the deck. The deck also features powerful spells such as Season of the Burrow and Sunfall to maintain board presence and control. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's control strategy, with a mix of utility lands and basic Plains to ensure smooth gameplay.

This deck focuses on maximizing the efficiency of casting Arclight Phoenix by utilizing cheap spells, card draw, and graveyard manipulation. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion to provide additional mana sources. Ledger Shredder, Picklock Prankster, and other low-cost spells help trigger Arclight Phoenix's recursion ability consistently. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Jwari Disruption to protect the strategy. With an emphasis on casting multiple spells per turn, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and quick creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively recur Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard using spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Spell Pierce and control the game with card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise. Additionally, the inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provides additional avenues for winning the game while maintaining pressure on the opponent. By combining efficient threats and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key concept is to maintain aggressive pressure through consistent damage output while utilizing the unique abilities of cards like Bomat Courier and Light Up the Stage to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional versatility and mana ramping potential. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast-paced aggression and efficient use of resources to secure victory.

The deck revolves around using the Greasefang Parhelion combo to generate value and overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Bitter Triumph, Grisly Salvage, and Cache Grab to dig for key pieces, the deck aims to control the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress while setting up the combo. Cards like Esika's Chariot and Parhelion II provide additional threats and value, while mana fixing and card draw ensure consistency. Overall, the deck focuses on exploiting the synergy between Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful board state and secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cheap spells to pump up creatures like Favored Hoplite and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck also includes cards like Crumb and Get It and Slickshot Show-Off for additional damage and utility. With a focus on quick and efficient creature attacks, supported by combat tricks and burn spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and end the game swiftly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility and consistency to the deck.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a strong Rakdos theme, utilizing cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Voldaren Thrillseeker, and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Tree of Perdition and Voldaren Epicure to maintain pressure. The use of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and versatility in gameplay. Additionally, the deck includes disruption and removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughseize to control the board and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to swiftly defeat opponents through a combination of creature aggression and spell disruption.

The Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Aloe Alchemist, Cunning Coyote, and Monastery Swiftspear alongside powerful spells like Atarka's Command and Play with Fire, the deck aims to deal damage early and often, putting pressure on the opponent to respond or risk being overwhelmed. The inclusion of Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provides additional reach in the late game, ensuring that the deck remains a threat even as the game progresses.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and resources while gaining value from discard effects. By using cards like Waste Not, Thoughtseize, and Duress, the deck aims to control the game by removing threats and limiting the opponent's options. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with creatures, as well as planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil for additional disruption. The deck's win condition comes from powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal.
